Continuous-time multistate model of growth bands

Source: R/state.R
wgh_msm.Rd

Fits a Markov multistate model (msm) to panel observations of height-for-age bands. Transitions are allowed between adjacent bands (default) or between all bands. Covariate effects can be constrained so that all upward transitions share one effect and all downward transitions another (constraint = "direction", the canalization study (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)). The likelihood is scaled automatically (fnscale) because large cohorts give objectives in the hundreds of thousands.

Usage

wgh_msm(
  data,
  covariates = NULL,
  transitions = c("adjacent", "full"),
  constraint = c("direction", "none"),
  age_origin = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Output of wgh_msm_data().

covariates

Covariate names.

transitions

"adjacent" or "full".

constraint

"direction" or "none".

age_origin

Age subtracted from age to form the time scale (default: the youngest age, so expected prevalences start at the observed starting distribution).

Value

An object of class wgh_msm with the msm fit.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("msm", quietly = TRUE)) {
  st <- wgh_states(growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$age >= 5, ])
  ms <- wgh_msm(wgh_msm_data(st), covariates = "sex")
  ms
}
